Text: Toggles the entire mod on or off.
Evaporation speed for water under structures/coverage (0%-400% of vanilla rate). 0% = no evaporation, 100% = vanilla rate, 200% = twice as fast, 400% = you do want to suffer, eh?
Evaporation speed for water in the open (0%-400% of vanilla rate). 0% = no evaporation, 100% = vanilla rate, 200% = twice as fast, 400% = you do want to suffer, eh?
How high above water to search for cover. Higher values detect taller structures but may impact performance on large maps.
How often to update coverage detection (1=faster, 10=slower). Roughly: 1≈half day, 5≈2 days, 10≈week.
